content:
noa: Quick heads-up — noticed a small but reproducible burst of WS reconnects from a set of EU tenants after the proxy change that reduced idle write buffers. Saw it around 07:18 UTC.
felix: Reduced write buffering? That was meant to lower tail latency. Any idea why reconnects spiked?
noa: Initial hypothesis: proxy is now half-closing sockets earlier on low-traffic connections; some clients treat half-close as terminal and immediately open a new connection. The race with session tombstones causes double-metering.
ops-bot: small log excerpt attached:
```
[07:18:03] proxy: conn=px-7a event=half_close idle_ms=18000
[07:18:03] session: tombstone id=sess-11 ttl_ms=30000
[07:18:04] client: reconnect start new_conn=px-7b
[07:18:04] metering: conn_open tenant=gamma tokens=1.0
```
console-team: Our sampling on ws.reconnect is set to 1% globally; we only caught a handful of traces. I can bump to 10% for the affected route-ids for 20m while we triage.
felix: Can we avoid billing impact immediately? Billing team, is there a quick filter we can apply?
billing-svc: Short-term: we can filter out events tagged with reconnect_reason=client_retry if they occur within a dedupe window. But right now reconnects coming from half-close flows lack that tag. If routing emits a tag we can ignore them temporarily.
noa: Two-pronged fix idea:
1) Add a small post-halfclose hold (post_halfclose_hold_ms) in the proxy so it waits ~150ms before tombstoning if it detects an immediate reconnect from the same client token/ip.
2) Annotate any reconnect caused by a proxy-initiated half-close with tag=halfclose_reconn so metering can exclude those within dedupe window.
felix: Config sketch:
```
proxy:
  reduce_write_buffer: true
  post_halfclose_hold_ms: 150
  annotate_halfclose_reconn: true
metering:
  dedupe_window_ms: 60000
```
console-team: I'll set sampling override for those tenant routes and add an ad-hoc dashboard showing ws.half_close.count, ws.reconnect.count and metering.duplicate_tokens.count. Also create an alert: if duplicate_tokens > 3/min AND reconnects > 8/min -> page.
billing-svc: Implementing tag-aware dedupe is quick but requires a small proto extension to accept reconnect_reason string. We'll default to ignoring unknown tags. I can push a hotfix to staging today.
ops-bot: planned staging deploy: proxy:feature/halfclose-annotate -> 08:45. CI green. Canary flag halfclose_hold_v1=0.1% scheduled at 09:00.
felix: Tests: unit for hold window, integration with simulated mobile SDK that reconnects immediately, and an e2e quick metering check to ensure no double-counting.
noa: Edge case: some clients intentionally re-open immediately and expect minimal downtime; adding 150ms hold might increase their reconnect latency slightly. Tradeoff seems acceptable compared to billing and session churn. We'll document in SDK notes.
felix: Rollout plan: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with console sampling bumps during the first three steps. If duplicate token metric rises, we rollback.
billing-svc: Action: add reconnect_reason tag handling and quick dedupe rule (PR).
console-team: Action: sampling bump + dashboard + paging alert (PR).
noa: Action: implement post_halfclose_hold + tagging (PR). I'll include telemetry that emits sse.halfclose_inferred=true when the proxy observes the pattern.
felix: Thanks all. Let's reconvene after the 30m canary window. If anyone sees >5 reconns/min for a tenant group, call it out and we'll pause rollout. :thumbsup:
